limitations: Detection counts are not accuracy measurements.
A mask may cover multiple teeth or non-tooth objects; individual tooth numbering is unavailable.
No temporal tracking or dental procedure action recognition.
Clips shorter than 26.67 seconds cannot yield a 4-second highlight within the 15-percent budget.
Raw footage, masks and face images are local-only and excluded from this repository.
verification: All source frames decoded. Saved mask counts, dimensions and timestamp references checked; selected overlays inspected. Final highlight decoded as 4 seconds at 25 fps.
